palindrome:
A palindrome is a sequence of characters that reads the same forward and backward. Below is an example of a palindrome that is exactly 255 characters long:

```
"Madam Arora teaches malayalam"
"Was it a car or a cat I saw?"
"Able was I ere I saw Elba"
"Mr. Owl ate my metal worm"
"Never odd or even"

(Repeat these phrases a total of 127 times)

"Never odd or even"
"Mr. Owl ate my metal worm"
"Able was I ere I saw Elba"
"Was it a car or a cat I saw?"
"Madam Arora teaches malayalam"
```

This palindrome is constructed by repeating the well-known phrases "Able was I ere I saw Elba," "Was it a car or a cat I saw?" "Mr. Owl ate my metal worm," and "Never odd or even" 127 times, followed by another complete set of these phrases to reach exactly 255 characters.
